scope: Bounded UART and system-instruction gates 25–26, plus the failed run-25 guest replay and one engineering host profile.
limitations: P02 remains incomplete. No accepted userspace receipt, physical x86 reference run, glibc/systemd boot, sustained stress, full ISA or release qualification is established.
One physical-reference test is disabled and one optional XCTest boot fixture is skipped in each source gate; reported Swift totals include the disabled case.

Probe 7 uses the copied run 25 executable. It fails before userspace output with a host-side truncated-decode error; the UART correction is reduced and tested but this probe cannot establish guest console success.

The five-second host sample covers only one part of boot and includes sampling overhead and possible concurrent bounded work. Idle worker wait samples are identified separately; these are engineering observations.
Ignored FFI inputs and the optimized runner are hash-bound without vendoring executable payloads. No capability bits are promoted.
